description.p: Save your SSH devices once, arrange live terminals in a grid, and reload the whole workspace with a click.

ul.li: SSH (password, key file or SSH agent), serial ports and local shells
Tabs split into resizable panes, restored on launch
Jump hosts, agent forwarding, local and SOCKS port forwards
Docked SFTP browser with a background transfer queue
Passwords stay in the system keyring; host keys are trusted on first use
